description: This script attempts to determine the source date epoch of a given source directory or file by checking for a version file, git, mercurial, or modification time, and outputs the epoch timestamp.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a version.date file in the source directory and reads its content as the source date epoch.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Uses git log to get the last commit timestamp for the source directory.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Uses hg log to get the last commit timestamp for the source directory.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Uses Perl to get the last modification time of the script itself.
